Der Spielkonfigurator hilft dir, 7’rizon: The game configurator helps you adapt 7’rizons for your university seminar. Your topic, intended learning activities and selected game mechanics become a worksheet with instructions and space for your own card texts. You can use fixed templates or ask AI to develop topic-specific suggestions.
7’rizons ist ein fächerübergreifendes Si: 7’rizons is an interdisciplinary simulation and role-playing project at the University of Bonn. Students and teachers create a fictional world together and develop its natural and social foundations. They contribute knowledge from different disciplines, take on roles and explore decisions in imagined scenarios. The project combines digital and analogue play with inquiry-based learning, supporting collaboration, perspective-taking and creative problem-solving. It is based at IMPULSE – House for Intellectual Innovation and Creativity; the Bonn Lab for Analog Games and Imaginative Play supports the shared framework for play.

Zu Beginn ___. Dann kehrt ___ in verände: At first ___. Then ___ returns in a different form. Who notices first?
Ein Gerücht wandert durch drei Gespräche: A rumour travels through three conversations. In the final scene it reaches the person who started it.
Was setzt den Aufbruch in Gang? An welch: What sets the departure in motion? Which event marks the turning point?
Aufbruch ___. Bruchpunkt ___. Danach ___: Departure ___. Turning point ___. Aftermath ___. Tell the transition from two perspectives.
Ein Archiv öffnet. Ein Dokument fehlt. D: An archive opens. A document is missing. Afterwards, two witnesses tell different stories.
Welche Phasen kennt dein Fach? Woran erk: Which phases does your subject distinguish? How can players recognise the transition?
Phasenfolge ___ → ___ → ___. Der Übergan: Sequence ___ → ___ → ___. The transition begins as soon as ___.
Beobachtung → Deutung → Gegenprobe. Die: Observation → interpretation → cross-check. The cross-check starts when two interpretations are on the table.
An welchem Phasenende lohnt sich eine Pa: At which phase boundary would a pause help? Which moment should players compare, assess or put in context?
Denkt an einen Moment aus dieser Phase,: Think of a moment in this phase when ___. How could you tell that ___?
Denkt an einen Satz, den zwei Figuren un: Recall a sentence that two characters understood differently. What in their replies gave that away?
Was müssen alle zu Beginn wissen? Welche: What must everyone know at the start? Which decision opens the first scene?
Alle wissen ___. Die Szene beginnt bei _: Everyone knows ___. The scene starts at ___. Who reacts first to ___?
Die Fähre hat abgelegt. Eine Tasche blei: The ferry has left. A bag remains on the bank. Who knows what is inside?
Zu welcher Ausgangsfrage soll die Gruppe: Which opening question should the group revisit? Which scene offers material for an answer?
Am Anfang dachten wir ___. In der Szene: At first we thought ___. In the scene ___, something changed: ___. What remains open?
Welche eurer ersten Vermutungen über den: Which of your first guesses about the letter changed? Name the scene that made the difference.
Wann sammelt ihr die liebsten Momente? I: When will you collect favourite moments? Which short phrase could bring one back later?
Mein liebster Moment war ___. Als kurze: My favourite moment was ___. The phrase I will take with me is “___”.
Als alle gleichzeitig schwiegen. Meine W: When everyone fell silent at once. My phrase for the next phase is “the loud pause”.
Welche Handkarten eröffnen verschiedene: Which cards offer different paths through the same scene? When do players make their choice?
Auf der Hand liegen ___ und ___. Ich spi: My hand contains ___ and ___. I play ___ now because ___.
Auf meiner Hand liegen „Nachfragen“ und: I hold “Ask” and “Wait”. I wait until the witness speaks up.
Wann darf jemand eine Karte anbieten? Wa: When can a player offer a card? What can the players negotiate about the next scene?
Ich biete dir ___ an. Dafür möchte ich _: I offer you ___. In exchange I would like ___. What do you propose?
Ich gebe dir „Widersprich“, wenn du mir: I will give you “Object” in exchange for “Ask”. Shall we continue the scene that way?
Welche Impulse funktionieren unabhängig: Which prompts work in any order? How can a random draw connect to the current scene?
Ziehe verdeckt. Greife ___ aus der Szene: Draw without looking. Take ___ from the scene and connect it to the prompt ___.
Du ziehst „Echo“. Wiederhole ein Wort au: You draw “Echo”. Repeat a word from the previous sentence. Another character explains what they hear in it.
Wer ist die Figur in deiner Spielwelt? W: Who is the character in your world? Which goal gives them a reason to act now?
Du bist ___. Du möchtest ___. Wende dich: You are ___. You want ___. Approach ___ to ___.
Du leitest das Stadtarchiv. Heute möchte: You run the city archive. Today you want to exhibit a disputed letter. Ask its owner for permission.
Welche Haltung lässt unterschiedliche Re: Which stance allows different reactions? In what encounter might it become visible?
Deine Haltung ist ___. Du hörst „___“. A: Your stance is ___. You hear “___”. Respond from that stance and ask another character how they understand the words.
Deine Haltung ist Skepsis. Jemand sagt z: Your stance is scepticism. Someone calls the headline “rather brave”. Reply and ask another character what they hear in that remark.
Welche Moderationsaufgabe lässt sich abg: Which facilitation task can someone take on? When should that person step in?
Aufgabe ___. Sobald ___, bitte die Grupp: Task ___. As soon as ___, ask the group for ___.
Du führst die Chronik. Am Phasenende lie: You keep the chronicle. At the end of the phase, read out two events. The group supplies a missing link.
Wann darf eine Figur die Szene spieleris: When may a character interrupt the scene as part of play? Who resumes the story after the reaction?
Wenn ___ geschieht, spiele diese Karte u: When ___ happens, play this card and ask ___. Then ___ continues the story.
Sobald zwei Figuren dieselbe Behauptung: When two characters make the same claim, ask for their reasons. The first character you asked then continues.
Was stellt eine knappe Ressource in dein: What does a scarce resource represent in your world? Which actions must players choose between?
Ressource ___. Einen Marker erhältst du: Resource ___. You earn a token for ___. You can spend it to ___.
Zeit ist knapp. Für jede vertagte Frage: Time is scarce. Each deferred question earns the group a time token. One token buys an extra interview.
Ohne Häkchen erhältst du die Übersicht d: Clear the checkbox for an overview of your selections.
Spielt eine kurze Szene mit eurem Entwur: Play a short scene using your design. Which action showed the learning activity you selected?
Für den nächsten Versuch ändern wir ___,: For the next round we will change ___ because during play ___.
